title: Launch distribution in legitimate channels
goal: Get the listing in front of Roblox developers without spam.
measurable_target: >= 3 posts in channels whose rules allow it, and >= 100 listing page views within 14 days (store analytics).
deliverable: List of post URLs + screenshot of store analytics after 14 days.
acceptance_criteria: At least 3 posts published by the owner, each following that channel's self-promotion rules
Listing views >= 100 within 14 days according to the store's own analytics
human_steps: Read marketing/channels.md; check each channel's current rules before posting.
Use the drafts in marketing/launch-posts.md (edit them in your own voice).
Post max once per channel; answer questions honestly.
After 14 days, record views/clicks from store analytics.
